fixed_at: 2026-10-24, K0, before any engine code existed

platform_measurement.machine: AMD Ryzen 5 5600G, 14 GiB RAM, ADATA SU630 SATA SSD, btrfs, Linux 7.2.11-arch1-1

c04_max_physical_factor.reason: design cap: max_segments = ceil(1.25 x volume / segment) + 4 segments; for 1 GiB and 8 MiB segments the file can reach 1.25 + 32 MiB/1 GiB + 1 MiB prefix = 1.282 x volume

caliente_fria.reason: greedy bound for 25 % spare is (1 + 0.25) / (2 x 0.25) = 2.5 for uniform traffic (Desnoyers 2012); hot/cold separation must stay at or below the uniform greedy bound

uniforme.reason: greedy bound 2.5 plus summary blocks (1/128), segment headers and cost-benefit victim choice; 1.0 of margin

c12_max_allocated_over_justified.reason: after compact() only the open hot and cold segments may hold dead or empty blocks; 15 % covers summary blocks and partially filled segments

c12_slack_bytes.reason: 4 segments of 8 MiB: open hot, open cold, file prefix and one segment of rounding

c15_max_pause_ms.reason: final delta below 1024 blocks = 4 MiB, about 10 ms at the measured 420 MiB/s, plus one fdatasync (max 1.6 ms measured) and a socket reconnect; 250 ms is a 10x margin over that bound

c22_max_relative_error.reason: the projection uses the same space and GC rules as the engine; 15 % covers segment rounding and GC trigger timing over 30 simulated days

c25_max_detection_ms.reason: heartbeat every 100 ms and failure timeout 500 ms (contract section 9), plus status polling every 50 ms and process scheduling; 3x the timeout
